name: film-stage
description: three.js parts of a film's stage that any film shares: the keyed camera with named eases and impact shake, and when a box is on screen (camera), a flickering lamp's level (flicker), fades to and from black over the whole frame (fade); a shot's In, Out and Combo animations on the camera (animate); titles, arrows and circles over the picture, CapCut's Text and Shapes (titles); docs/film-grammar.md: why each cut, move and sound
